page.notes: The entries are printed in italic, with the page numbers in roman at the right. The heading CAPITUM is set in spaced capitals. Some letters are blurred by print and stains, so "characĕre", "æque" and "fidelibus" are best readings. The signature mark reads as "* §" or "* 5" and I give it as "* 5".
